newsitem.title: CHINA: Asean Resources in talks to sell assets.
newsitem.headline: Asean Resources in talks to sell assets.

text.p: Property concern Huey Tai International Ltd and its subsidiary Asean Resources Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday they were in talks with a third party on the sale of Asean's assets.
"Huey Tai and Asean have been approached by an independent third party with a view of acquiring certain assets of Asean by such independent third party," the companies said in a joint statement.
The statement said the proposed transaction was at a preliminary stage and that no detailed figures had been finalised.
It gave no details of the third party.
Huey Tai currently owns 71.83 percent of Asean, it said.
Shares of Huey Tai were HK$0.14 lower at HK$1.34 in late morning. Asean shares were down HK$0.225 to HK$2.575.
